input: "Run $1 then $2. All: $@. Slice: ${@:2}. Slice3: ${@:1:2}. Args: $ARGUMENTS."
args: ["build","test","lint"]
expected: "Run build then test. All: build test lint. Slice: test lint. Slice3: build test. Args: build test lint."

input: "Pos: ${1:-fallback}. Empty: ${2:-fallback}. All: ${@:-fallback}. Args: ${ARGUMENTS:-fallback}."
args: ["build"]
expected: "Pos: build. Empty: fallback. All: build. Args: build."

input: "No args: ${1:-x} ${@:-none} ${ARGUMENTS:-none} $1 $@."
args: []
expected: "No args: x none none  ."

input: "$0 | ${0:-def} | $1 | ${@:0} | ${@:2:1} | ${@:9}"
args: ["a","b"]
expected: " | def | a | a b | b | "

input: "Keep literal args: $1 $2."
args: ["$@ and $ARGUMENTS and $1"]
expected: "Keep literal args: $@ and $ARGUMENTS and $1 ."

input: "Slice bounds: ${@:5} | ${@:2:1} | ${@:1:9}."
args: ["a","b","c"]
expected: "Slice bounds:  | b | a b c."
